headline: Executive order sets the order of officials who would lead the Department of Homeland Security if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which Department of Homeland Security officials would step in to act as Secretary if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or are otherwise unable to do the job. Orders like this are meant to keep the department running without a gap in leadership. No summary was provided, so the specific positions and their ranking are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior Department of Homeland Security officials
who_it_affects.how: They may be called on to serve as acting head of the department in the ranked order the order sets out.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 3, 2025; the exact effective date is not stated in the available information.
